package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

type CreateInput struct {
	StudentID        string
	IdempotencyKey   string
	GoalCode         string
	LearningPathID   string
	DiagnosticPlanID string
	Intent           domain.PlanningIntent
}

type Create struct {
	Requests           repository.CoursePlanRepository
	DiagnosticRequests repository.DiagnosticInitialAllocationRepository
	IDs                IDGenerator
	Clock              Clock
}

func (useCase Create) Handle(ctx context.Context, input CreateInput) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.GoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalCode))
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.DiagnosticPlanID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DiagnosticPlanID)
	intent, intentErr := domain.NormalizePlanningIntent(input.Intent)
	if useCase.Requests == nil || useCase.IDs == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || input.StudentID == "" ||
		input.IdempotencyKey == "" || input.GoalCode == "" || len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || intentErr != nil ||
		(intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonReplan && input.LearningPathID == "") ||
		(intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonInitial && input.LearningPathID != "") {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if input.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && (intent.Source != domain.PlanningSourceTeacher || intent.Reason != domain.PlanningReasonInitial || input.IdempotencyKey != input.DiagnosticPlanID) {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if input.DiagnosticPlanID != "" {
		if lookup, ok := useCase.Requests.(repository.DiagnosticPlanningRepository); ok {
			prior, lookupErr := lookup.GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(ctx, input.StudentID, input.DiagnosticPlanID)
			if lookupErr != nil && !errors.Is(lookupErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, lookupErr
			}
			if lookupErr == nil && prior.IdempotencyKey != input.IdempotencyKey {
				return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
			}
		}
	}
	requestHash, err := hashCreateInputWithDiagnostic(input.GoalCode, input.LearningPathID, input.DiagnosticPlanID, intent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	request, err := domain.NormalizeCoursePlanRequest(domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: useCase.IDs.NewID(), StudentID: input.StudentID, IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey,
		RequestHash: requestHash, GoalCode: input.GoalCode, LearningPathID: input.LearningPathID, DiagnosticPlanID: input.DiagnosticPlanID,
		Intent: intent, Status: domain.CoursePlanPlanning,
		NextAttemptAt: now, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	stored, created, err := useCase.Requests.CreateOrGet(ctx, request)
	if err == nil && !created && input.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && stored.Status == domain.CoursePlanFailed && stored.FailureCode == domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts {
		if useCase.DiagnosticRequests == nil {
			return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		stored, err = useCase.DiagnosticRequests.ResumeDiagnosticPlanning(ctx, stored.StudentID, stored.ID, now)
	}
	return stored, created, err
}

func hashCreateInputWithDiagnostic(goalCode string, learningPathID string, diagnosticPlanID string, intent domain.PlanningIntent) (string, error) {
	if diagnosticPlanID == "" { // preserve v1 omitted hash bytes exactly.
		return hashCreateInputLegacy(goalCode, learningPathID, intent)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		GoalCode         string                `json:"goal_code"`
		LearningPathID   string                `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		Intent           domain.PlanningIntent `json:"intent"`
		DiagnosticPlanID string                `json:"diagnostic_plan_id"`
	}{GoalCode: goalCode, LearningPathID: learningPathID, Intent: intent, DiagnosticPlanID: diagnosticPlanID})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}
func hashCreateInput(goalCode string, learningPathID string, intent domain.PlanningIntent) (string, error) {
	return hashCreateInputLegacy(goalCode, learningPathID, intent)
}
func hashCreateInputLegacy(goalCode string, learningPathID string, intent domain.PlanningIntent) (string, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		GoalCode       string                `json:"goal_code"`
		LearningPathID string                `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		Intent         domain.PlanningIntent `json:"intent"`
	}{goalCode, learningPathID, intent})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	d := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(d[:]), nil
}
